digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate / LLM agent call loop guard
propositions: The completion verifier trips RunawayToolLoopError on repeated file reads despite memoization, because the runaway guard (outermost layer) counts guard-observable calls before the memo layer serves cached responses
Memo-served (free) repeat reads that should be invisible to loop detection fill the guard's distinct-ratio window and incorrectly trigger a loop abort
The guard and memo layers fight each other: lever 2 (memo path-normalized cache) made repeats cheap; the guard still punishes them as loop evidence
The fix recomposes guard and memo via a shared ToolCallLedger that tracks only EXECUTED calls (not memo-served), so cache hits no longer falsely increment loop evidence
A pure cache-served loop (zero execution for a full window) is still bounded by a served-streak backstop arm that remains distinct from the ratio arm
